name: Danger Detection
text:
**Danger Detection**: Song’o halflings have learned to hone in on any indication of danger. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +4 racial bonus on Perception checks to notice a creature using Stealth, as well as Perception checks to notice a weapon being drawn or a hidden trap (or similar signs of danger, subject to the GM’s discretion).

This replaces keen senses.
